audit.whatIsWrong: Level 2 read Skill and Level 3 read Zac in both layers while whys[1] and whys[2] say you stay ahead and win the exchange cleanly, and first item read Zac while whys[5] says the first bruiser item lets you out-duel and shove him.
audit.why: packet.levelChart is Wukong / Wukong / Wukong / Zac / Wukong / Wukong / Zac and the prose matches it. Rows 0, 3, 4 and 6 were already right and are untouched.
audit.corrected: Rows 1, 2 and 5 set to Wukong as matched phases[N].side + win[N] pairs, ratings realigned across the chart, and the stage explanations rewritten with the mechanic behind each row.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[4].why was the generic Cyclone line, phases[6].why quoted a carry-threat number, and the page named none of Zac's abilities beyond Elastic Slingshot (packet.defects).
audit.why: Let's Bounce! is 120/105/90s and bounces four times knocking up — outside it his single-target output is Unstable Matter chip, which is why Level 6 is yours. At two items his value moves to the teamfight: the engage, the four knock-ups and the bloblet revive.
audit.corrected: Level 6 stage now names Let's Bounce! and its 120s rank-1 cooldown; the 2+ item stage names the engage, knock-ups and revive as team value rather than duel value; Unstable Matter and Stretching Strikes now appear by name.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page credits Zac's healing to an 'E heal' in whys[3], mid and wants.foe[0]. Riot's text gives no healing on Elastic Slingshot at all — the heal is the passive, which sheds a reabsorbable chunk every time an ability hits an enemy. dosFull[1] 'Step on his blobs', dosFull[2], dontsFull[0], dontsFull[1] and dontsFull[2] all carried bodies copied from other rows, and packet.defects records zero cooldown-sequencing lines on the page.
audit.why: Riot's text: the passive sheds a chunk on every ability hit that restores health when reabsorbed, and on fatal damage he splits into 4 bloblets and revives only if any survive. Unstable Matter is a flat 5s dealing a percentage of max health. Elastic Slingshot is 21/18/15/12/9s and is charged in place before launching.
audit.corrected: The heal is re-attributed to the shed blobs in whys[3] and wants.foe[0]; dosFull[1].d states walking over the chunks; dontsFull[0].d states the revive depends on a surviving bloblet; dosFull[2].d states the charge-in-place tell; dontsFull[1].d and breakdown.cooldowns carry the 21s and 9s Slingshot, the 5s percent-health W and the 120s R.

audit.whatIsWrong: The kit's derived flags put 'grounding' on Elastic Slingshot.
audit.why: Riot's own description is only 'Zac attaches his arms to the ground and stretches back, launching himself forward' — no grounding effect. Per the calibration rule the description wins over a derived flag, so I asserted no grounding anywhere.
